name: m2-baseline-2026-10-30
note: Milestone 2 checkpoint (~10.7M params, BPE vocab 1024, 5000 iters, ~6MB corpus). Recorded in docs/EVALUATION.md. A candidate must not regress below these on the ENFORCED, tokenizer-independent metrics. perplexity and next-token top-k are tokenizer-dependent, so they are recorded for reference but NOT gated across models with a different vocab (e.g. the M3 vocab-2048 model).
